svg.title: Viikki: daily GPP, Reco and gap-filled NEE (g C m-2 d-1), air temperature, soil water content and precipitation from 2022-01-01 to 2025-12-31, with the recorded management events. A dashed line marks a second date of the same event in another source.
svg.desc: Four panels on one date axis (local time, UTC+2) from 2022-01-01 to 2025-12-31. 1461 days with gap-filled NEE; 722 days with a measured fraction of NEE below 10 % are drawn lighter. Daily GPP from −2.2 to 18.0, Reco from 0.0 to 10.0 and NEE from −12.2 to 6.3 g C m-2 d-1 (NEE < 0 = uptake). 22 recorded events in the period (7 harvest, 5 tillage, 1 sowing, 7 fertilisation, 2 spraying), drawn as vertical lines with a type label above panel (a). Largest change of daily GPP near each event: harvest 2022-07-01: GPP drop on 2022-06-29 (−2 d, clear); harvest 2022-08-27: GPP drop on 2022-08-20 (−7 d, clear); tillage 2022-11-01: GPP drop on 2022-10-23 (−9 d, not clear); tillage 2023-04-28: GPP drop on 2023-04-27 (−1 d, clear); tillage 2023-05-25: GPP drop on 2023-05-26 (+1 d, clear); harvest 2023-08-17: GPP drop on 2023-08-17 (0 d, clear); harvest 2024-06-14: GPP drop on 2024-06-13 (−1 d, not clear); harvest 2024-07-31: GPP drop on 2024-07-29 (−2 d, clear); tillage 2024-10-09: GPP drop on 2024-10-11 (+2 d, not clear); tillage 2025-05-08: GPP drop on 2025-05-05 (−3 d, not clear); harvest 2025-09-10: GPP drop on 2025-09-12 (+2 d, clear). Tillage 2022-11-01: the docx source gives 2022-11-02; the largest GPP drop is on 2022-10-23 (−9 d from the used date, −10 d from the other date), nearer to the used date. Grey bands: thermal growing season, 2022: 2022-05-04 to 2022-11-13 (193 d); 2023: 2023-04-17 to 2023-10-17 (183 d); 2024: 2024-04-27 to 2024-12-03 (220 d); 2025: 2025-04-13 to 2025-12-21 (252 d).
